notes.title: 2024's biggest roguelike surprise gets new update and 40% off sale
notes.notes:
I'm always on the lookout for incredible roguelikes, and Go Mecha Ball started this year with a bang. You bounce around the levels in this fast-paced twin-stick shooter, flawlessly swapping between pinball and mech forms in some of the smoothest controls the genre has on offer. Drenched in bright neon and filled with banging tunes, you hit enemies, walls, and boost pads before quickly popping off shots and racing around the stage again. The Steam and Game Pass release was already a lot of fun, and now an update and sale make it the perfect time to dive in.

notes.title: GO MECHA BALL - ARCADE UPDATE 🎰
notes.notes:
[h2]Good day ballers! Hope you are well. 🏐[/h2]
It's been almost six months since we released Go Mecha Ball. We've been honoured by all the love and support from the community. And we're back with a new update, with a brand new mode that you can jump into right now!
[h1]ARCADE MODE NOW AVAILABLE 🎰 [/h1] 
[list]
[*] Unlock a new arcade mode challenge when you defeat a difficulty for the first time
[*] Arcade mode is a score chasing mode where you can earn permanent upgrades for each character by earning bronze, silver and gold medals
[*] Complete the highest difficulty to earn shiny new skins!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44245640/5a5529e07a76ee0ec6a09f2f7b6c1233142bff80.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44245640/b5266327c383ad04036f7b7ff4d77e4983536e3e.gif[/img]

[h2]Here are the rest of the patch notes[/h2] 
[h3]Bosses[/h3] [list]
[*] Bosses are more aggressive and attack more frequently
[*] Less health replenished when defeating bosses
[*] Glitched bosses gain more health, deal more damage and get new attacks with each difficulty level
[*] Glitched bosses fire projectiles after certain attacks
[*] Glitched bosses teleport around the stage [/list]
[h3]Combo System[/h3] [list]
[*] Less forgiving combo system to improve gold coin economy balance and combo-based upgrade synergies
[*] Combo timer no longer freezes entirely while in the air or using mobility features like transport tubes
[*] Combo timer slows down while in the air, in boost mode and while abilities are active
[*] Dealing damage with abilities now resets the combo timer [/list]
[h3]Shop[/h3] [list]
[*] Shop always offers health packs
[*] Shop contents are deterministic, so no more shop scumming [/list]
[h3]Performance[/h3] [list]
[*] Much improved CPU efficiency
[*] Reduced physics time step to free up CPU and GPU resources
[*] More than halved memory usage in common situations
[*] Many times faster startup loading and level loading performance
[*] Optimized for Steam Deck: 60FPS without VSync
[*] VSync no longer enabled by default
[*] UI drawn as overlay rather than using a separate camera
[*] More reliable occlusion and frustum culling
[*] Improved GPU batching for reduced draw calls
[*] Improved shadow quality [/list]
[h3]Settings Menu[/h3] [list]
[*] Full input remapping for keyboard, mouse and controllers
[*] Added headers to settings menu for greater readability
[*] Added camera zoom options to set camera range
[*] Toggle dynamic or static camera to help some players who experienced motion sickness from subtle camera movements [/list]

Keep on ballin' and play the new update now 👇
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2008510/Go_Mecha_Ball/

- Whale Peak Games & Super Rare Originals

notes.title: Go Mecha Ball, out today on Steam and Game Pass, is a swish blend of twin-stick shooting and pinball physics
notes.notes:
Friends, it is finally time for me to discourse unto you about my great love of balls. The roots of my enthusiasm go back to pinball machines - both the fancier, arcade variety that transmogrify into e.g. screaming robot skulls when you achieve a high-enough multiplier, and the crappy, play-at-home variety that are basically a canted wooden sheet with some numbers drawn on it. But it wasn't till I embraced the holy medium of videogames that I realised the full potential of balldom.

Initiated, of course, by Sonic the Hedgehog, I descended into a frothing ballpit of ball variations, encompassing everything from the squashy rolling UFOs of Exo One through Katamari Damacy to the overcrowded chutes of Marble World and the spectacle of Overwatch's Hammond clearing out a capture point by means of sheer, delicious torque. I am always up for a game in which you either control or become a ball, and Go Mecha Ball looks like one of the better ones.

notes.title: January's second wave of new Xbox Game Pass titles revealed - includes 'Pokemon with guns'
notes.notes:
Xbox has taken the cover off the next batch of titles coming to Game Pass as January draws to a close and we kick on into February (don’t worry the speed at which time moves scares me too).

Kicking things off today (January 16) - on Cloud, Console, and PC - is Those Who Remain, a psychological horror thriller released back in 2020 by developer Camel 101. As you progress through its story, you'll be exploring the unsettling setting of Dormont, which is “a town in a spiralling split from the fabric of reality, warped by darkness and the deeds of its Citizens”.

Both F1 23 and Turnip Boy Robs a Bank are set to arrive in the service on January 18, with both offering high-octane action, but in quite different ways. The former is only hitting Console and PC, with its main draw being the chance to race an F1 car and see if you can stop Max Vestappen from winning all the time.

notes.title: NextFest Demo - Steam Deck Fix
notes.notes:
Hey there, Ballers! Great to see everyone enjoying the demo, it's really rather heartwarming to experience after years of hard work. We also unfortunately noticed that some users ran into problems on Steam Deck, with the game appearing to download instantly and only taking up 0kb. To fix this, you need to:

- Go to the Go Mecha Ball page in your Steam library
- Open the Settings menu via the cogwheel icon on the far right edge of the screen next to the controller icon
- Select "Properties..."
- Go to the Compatiblity tab
- Enable "Force the use of a specific Steam Play compatibility tool
- Open Proton pulldown and select Proton Experimental
- Go back out to the Go Mecha Ball page, and an update should start downloading
- If the update does not start right away, press the update button to start it
- If the update button is greyed out, leave the Go Mecha Ball game page and reopen it to enable the update button
- Once the update is installed, the game should run


If you have any further issues, do jump into our Discord and let us know!

Have fun!
The Mecha Ball Team <3

notes.title: Rocket League meets Super Monkey Ball in new Steam roguelike demo
notes.notes:
Go Mecha Ball is by far the coolest Steam Next Fest demo I've played so far, and I can't recommend it enough. A top-down, twin-stick shooter where you can turn into a giant mecha wrecking ball that bounces around the tight playspaces while shooting at enemies, Go Mecha Ball is a fast-paced roguelike that genuinely had me upset when I got to the end of the demo. It's a little bit Super Monkey Ball and has the bright bouncy play of something like Rocket League, it's great.
